observations.title: Explore Voyager structures
observations.player_action: Travel through newly generated terrain and investigate the author's generated structures.
observations.outcome: Structures use vanilla blocks and entities to supply exploration, encounters and loot; content differs by template and release.
conditions: Existing generated chunks are not assumed to regenerate structures.
Placement frequency and permitted biomes must be read from the exact installed worldgen data and pack overrides.
Author documentation can cover newer releases; installed version is 5.0.8.
observations.review_note: Exact quest criterion and world-state result were not exercised; a custom signal must observe the action, not a manual checkmark.

observations.title: Native structure and loot ownership
observations.player_action: Use the installed structure definitions and JEM encounter registration when preparing an exploration objective.
observations.outcome: The mod's worldgen resources own placement and template content; an author project page is not proof of a live structure position or hosted boss eligibility.
conditions: Do not infer a manual boss allowlist, server marker or quest criterion from the structure's name.
No local world was loaded or regenerated.
Author documentation can cover newer releases; installed version is 5.0.8.
observations.review_note: Exact quest criterion and world-state result were not exercised; a custom signal must observe the action, not a manual checkmark.
